description_en: Queries the details of communication records in a channel. You can query data within the last 180 days
description_zh: 获取频道通信记录详情，支持查询近180天内的数据
kebab_example: aliyun rtc describe-rtc-channel-metric --time-point 2018-01-29T00:00:00Z --app-id aoe0000 --channel-id testId --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRtcChannelMetric

parameters.help_en:
The time when the record is queried, in UTC. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format.

The time granularity is day
parameters.help_zh:
查询记录时间，UTC格式，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

时间粒度为天
parameters.name: time_point

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can create and query the application ID in the console. Only a single ID is supported
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，可通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The channel ID. Only a single ID is supported
parameters.name: channel_id
